bounded_host_request.command:
set -u
echo 'GDRIVE_DIAGNOSTIC_BEGIN'
printf 'WHO='; id -un
printf 'WSL_DISTRO='; printf '%s\n' "${WSL_DISTRO_NAME:-UNKNOWN}"
printf 'G_MOUNT='; findmnt -T /mnt/g -no TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS 2>&1 || true
printf 'MNT_STATUS='; ls -ld /mnt /mnt/g 2>&1 || true
printf 'G_ROOT_CONTENTS='; timeout 8s ls -la /mnt/g 2>&1 | head -35 || true
printf 'EXACT_PATH_STATUS='; stat /mnt/g/GserverStorage 2>&1 | head -12 || true
printf 'WINDOWS_TEST='; if command -v powershell.exe >/dev/null 2>&1; then timeout 15s powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command '$p="G:\GserverStorage"; "EXISTS="+(Test-Path -LiteralPath $p); Get-Item -LiteralPath $p -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName' 2>&1 | head -12; else echo WINDOWS_INTEROP_UNAVAILABLE; fi
printf 'WSL_AUTOMOUNT_CONFIG='; if test -f /etc/wsl.conf; then sed -n '1,60p' /etc/wsl.conf; else echo DEFAULT; fi
printf 'USERBOT_STATUS='; systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true
echo 'GDRIVE_DIAGNOSTIC_END'
